messages:
lia-sales: Customer question: can we support an air-gapped warm standby with monthly security patches but minimal transport cost? They want pricing and a clear bootstrap recipe.

 tom-se: Short answer: yes. We offer two packaging profiles: full-replica (everything shipped) and warm-compact (runtime + compacted cache). Tradeoffs: replica = faster failover, bigger transport. compact = smaller bundles, slightly slower first requests.

 rita-eng: Numbers: example minibundle sizes from recent builds: full-replica ~3.2GB, warm-compact ~820MB. Typical delta patches (config & small fixes) ~50-200MB; model-weight diffs vary (0.5-6GB) if quantization changes.

 olga-security: Security checklist: signed manifest + SHA256 checksums, SBOM included, optional HSM signing. For airgap installs we support offline key injection and record signed attestations.

 pkg-bot: Build artifact sample: onprem-warm-2026-04 (full 3.2GB, compact 820MB) manifest.sig present.

 lia-sales: Pricing model suggestion: monthly standby base fee (holds capacity + support) + metered failover/run-hours. Offer credits for scheduled DR drills (e.g., 4 small tests/year included).

 tom-se: Operational note: to meet sub-2min failover you need full-replica preloaded and prefix cache persisted. If relying on physical media transfer, expect 5-20min depending on media speed and extraction time.

 rita-eng: Installer snippet for runbook: `rwdctl install --bundle ./bundle.tar.gz --verify ./manifest.sig --inject-key ./hsm-token.pem` and offline healthcheck `rwdctl healthcheck --mode offline`.

 olga-security: Action: I'll draft short attestation text and HSM key-injection steps to include in SOW.

 lia-sales: Action: I'll send pricing sketch and transport options to customer. Thanks all.
